browser_verification.details: All 56 focused Chromium tests and all 12 new regressions in installed Google Chrome pass. Isolated Chrome/Chromium browser regressions exercise generation with pre-existing HARM, unchanged unselected PCM, live/phrase/full-render voice rates, portable GUI import and saved reload, undo/redo, clipboard and repeat/section operations, plus real AudioBufferSourceNode lifetime tests with a simulated MIDI device. The simulated MIDI input drives the production MIDI handler, not mocked audio. No hardware S2400 or physical MIDI-device acceptance is claimed. Existing user-profile song remains untouched.
